ITEM 1 | Dark brown-black charred crust on one side, transitioning to light orange-tan flesh with flaky, fibrous texture and a few small pale specks; roughly oval piece about 6 cm long by 4 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick, slightly glossy, holds its shape, sits alone on the left of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Orange-red to golden-brown pieces with ruffled, shredded, fibrous texture and crisp-looking edges, some darker browned spots; irregular flat sheet-like cluster about 8 cm by 6 cm and 1 cm thick, dry-looking with slight sheen, on the right side of the plate | 85
ITEM 3 | Bright green fibrous strands, limp and moist, tangled with small orange-tan bits; small irregular cluster about 4 cm by 3 cm and under 1 cm thick, sitting between items 1 and 2 near the center | 12
